title: 早
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L208 早. Latest origin/main at production time includes L204 流 and L205 河, but L206 從 and L207 進 are not yet merged, so this is a dependency-blocked lesson-local package. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only. Images must be square 1:1 compositions using approved L058 style anchors, with no text, numbers, signs, labels, logos, zhuyin, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 teach audio, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: origin/main production JSON through L205 河 plus provisional learned chars 從 and 進 plus current target 早
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, school names, dates, scoreboards, jersey numbers, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice or cut production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 孩子正在看自己小時候學畫畫的照片或作品，也可以是一旁有現在的孩子和較小時候的孩子畫面對照。畫面要表現「從小就學畫畫」，不可有文字、日期、數字、標籤或可辨識書寫內容。

approvedSentences.text: 不用太早進去，學校還沒開。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 不用太早進去學校還沒開
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 孩子和家人在學校門口外，學校門還沒開，家人像是在提醒不用太早進去。校門不可有校名、文字、數字、標籤或招牌。
足球比賽畫面，一個孩子剛把球踢進球門，表現很早就進球得分的情境。不可有比分、球衣號碼、文字、隊名、標籤或看板。
孩子從河邊走上人行道，畫面要同時看得到河邊與人行道，動作方向清楚。不可有文字、數字、路牌或標籤。
小河的河水持續流動，畫面重點是河水流個不停，可用連續水流表現，不需要人物。不可有文字、數字、標籤或聲音字樣。

G01.reason: 「太早」是本課核心時間用法，目標字清楚。
